title: GLG Expert Content Reaches Bloomberg Terminal via ASKB AI Interface
summary: Industry coverage reported that GLG's Expert Content Library became accessible to Bloomberg Terminal clients through ASKB, Bloomberg's conversational AI interface, in beta. The integration places GLG's expert insights inside a workflow used widely across buy-side and sell-side desks, alongside the firm's reimagined myGLG platform.
whyItMatters: Distributing expert content through third-party AI surfaces like Bloomberg's ASKB mirrors the content-distribution strategy pursued by Third Bridge and Guidepoint, reinforcing that expert networks increasingly compete on where their insights can be consumed, not just on call access.
